title: MediaRow missing Debug and Clone derives
description: In fieldwork-db/src/media_db.rs, MediaRow (line 9) has no derive attributes at all. Every other row type in the codebase (ArticleRow, CollectionRow, BookRow, ReviewRow, TrackRow, AudioChannelRow, PodcastSeriesRow, PodcastEpisodeRow) derives at least Debug and Clone. Missing Debug makes the type unloggable; missing Clone prevents copying rows when needed. Standards: 'Debug on almost everything, Clone when callers will copy.'
